codeReview.summary: This fix closes the two sampling-policy blockers from the prior failed review: order-bias validation now enforces declared schedule semantics and seed/entry integrity, and measured CLI now exits non-zero on sampling gate failure. Core feature requirements are met.

issues.description: `run_manifest.json` is written before `sampling_gate_failure` is added (line 986), and there is no subsequent write in `run_measured`. CLI exit behavior is correct in-process, but the persisted manifest does not carry the added failure details.

`TestMeasuredCLISamplingGate` does not exercise CLI exit-code behavior; it validates `validate_sampling` directly. The non-zero measured CLI behavior is currently covered by manual command evidence rather than an automated CLI-level test.
